name: wwp-film-workflow
description: Repo-local Codex skills and helpers for WWP film and series production workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Run resumable WWP film production and work enrichment in one serial workflow.
interface.longDescription: Project-local Codex workflow rules for explicit human/AI handoffs, ingesting new resources, preventing duplicate works, maintaining metadata-first catalog entries, selecting films and series, acquiring missing Chinese subtitle candidates through local browser companions or APIs, creating work/spec/episode pages early, encoding browser-compatible playable MP4 variants, resumably uploading them to Notion, writing Media Assets, verifying live website sync, backfilling manual uploads, handling source archives, and filling structured film metadata through identity, Douban, OMDb, TMDb, and AI advisory lanes. Series delivery defaults to one file per episode; collections require an explicit instruction.
interface.defaultPrompt: When the user says 开始制作影视库, run the complete WWP workflow with release-first batch coverage. Visibility is a playback gate, not a perfection gate: keep a title visible and release any correctly mapped uploaded path with no concrete viewing failure; minor defects, incomplete metadata/specs, Needs Review, and routine human confirmation are follow-up work, not publication blockers. Hide only the affected path for an evidenced viewing failure, and hide the whole work only when every usable path is affected or the user explicitly requests a hold. After the bounded film checkpoint, continue the saved enrichment campaign serially through base metadata, People, honors, and highlights. Apply guarded cleanup moves for eligible items, report every residual source and enrichment blocker, and never stop at a routing plan while due work remains.
